avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sucralfate binds iron in the GI tract, reducing iron absorption by 20-50%
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; take iron supplements 2 hours before or 6 hours after sucralfate

avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sucralfate may bind calcium, reducing bioavailability of both agents
avoid_supplements.action: Administer calcium supplements at least 2 hours apart from sucralfate

avoid_supplements.name: Zinc supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sucralfate binds zinc in the GI lumen, significantly reducing zinc absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Space dosing by at least 2 hours; monitor for zinc deficiency signs if concurrent use necessary

avoid_supplements.name: Fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sucralfate may impair absorption of fat-soluble vitamins through altered GI absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor vitamin status; consider supplementation if prolonged sucralfate therapy (>4 weeks)

caution_supplements.name: Phosphate binders/Calcium phosphate supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential for additive binding effects in the GI tract
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for constipation and nutrient malabsorption; maintain adequate hydration

caution_supplements.name: Antacids (aluminum-based)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Both agents work locally in GI tract; aluminum from antacids may accumulate with prolonged concurrent use
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; prefer magnesium-based antacids if needed; monitor for aluminum toxicity with chronic use

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Fat may reduce sucralfate's local protective effects by altering gastric pH and mucosal coating
caution_foods.action: Take sucralfate 1 hour before meals on an empty stomach for optimal efficacy

caution_foods.name: Acidic foods/beverages (citrus, tomato, vinegar)
caution_foods.mechanism: Acidic environment may theoretically affect sucralfate's binding and protective mechanism
caution_foods.action: Avoid immediately before/after sucralfate administration; not absolute contraindication

monitoring_notes: Sucralfate is minimally absorbed systemically but significantly binds minerals and drugs in the GI tract; separate administration of iron, calcium, zinc, and most other medications by at least 2 hours. Monitor for signs of mineral deficiency with prolonged therapy (>4 weeks), particularly iron and zinc status.
